postings.title: AI Architect
postings.description:
About the Role 

We are looking for an exceptional AI Architect to design, build, and optimize AI-driven applications on the Azure platform. This role emphasizes strong engineering expertise, creative problem-solving, and the ability to work with cutting-edge technologies to deliver high-impact solutions. 

The ideal candidate thrives on solving complex challenges, is passionate about engineering excellence, and has a knack for integrating AI into scalable, real-world applications. A background in data science or formal engineering is a strong advantage, given the scientific nature of the work. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Architect & Build: Design and implement AI applications leveraging Azure services (AKS, Azure Container Apps, Blob Storage, Document Intelligence, AI Studio/Foundry, VNETs). 

- Full-Stack Development: Develop systems using Python, React, and modern frameworks like Entity Framework Core, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and FastAPI. 

- Scalable & Secure Solutions: Create applications that are resilient, secure, and optimized for high performance. 

- Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and engineers, to turn abstract ideas into functional solutions. 

- Cloud-Native Focus: Lead the deployment and optimization of applications in Azure environments with strong consideration for cost efficiency and maintainability. 

- Innovate & Optimize: Explore new tools, frameworks, and methodologies to stay at the forefront of AI and software engineering. 

What We’re Looking For 

Required Skills: 

- Proven expertise in software engineering with experience in C#, Python, and React (TypeScript). 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including services like AKS, Networking, and AI Studio/Foundry. 

- Familiarity with AI frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and other AI libraries or tools, as well as techniques such as RAG, Agentic patterns, and workflow orchestration. 

- Strong grasp of modern development practices, such as containerization, CI/CD, and API design. 

- Demonstrated ability to design and build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Background in data science or formal training in engineering disciplines. 

- Experience with frameworks like Entity Framework Core, Material UI, and FastAPI. 

- Understanding of AI modeling workflows and integration of document intelligence or related tools. 

Core Qualities: 

- Problem-Solving Excellence: A creative and analytical approach to tackling technical challenges. 

- Ownership & Accountability: Ability to take full responsibility for the design, implementation, and success of projects. 

- Adaptability: Comfortable learning and implementing new technologies in a fast-evolving field. 

- Team Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a mindset that thrives in a team-driven environment. 

About Nimble Gravity 

Nimble Gravity is a team of outdoor enthusiasts, adrenaline seekers, and experienced growth hackers. We love solving hard problems and believe the right data can transform and propel growth for any organization.

postings.title: Conservation Support Engineer – Latin America
postings.description:
Help protected areas across Latin America turn data into conservation impact 

EarthRanger is used by more than 1,000 protected areas and conservation programs worldwide, and Latin America is growing fast. National park agencies, NGOs, and community-run reserves from Argentina and Brazil to Costa Rica and Honduras rely on EarthRanger to see what is happening across their landscapes in real time: ranger patrols, wildlife tracking, sensors, and field reports brought together on one map. Setting up a site is a first step. The real work is helping a team go from having EarthRanger to relying on it every day to plan patrols, respond to incidents, and show results to the people who fund and govern their work. That is this job. 

What will you do? 

Help sites succeed, not just get set up 

- Work with protected areas and conservation organizations across Latin America to understand their conservation goals and shape how they use EarthRanger to reach them.

- Own a set of sites in the region that were set up but never became active, and bring them into daily use. This is a first-year goal we will define with you.

- Follow up with sites after onboarding, spot where adoption has stalled, and coach teams through the next step: better patrol coverage, cleaner reporting, smarter use of alerts and analysis.

- Act as the regional voice of the user, feeding what sites need back to our product, documentation, and training teams. 

Support and troubleshoot 

- Be a first point of contact for user questions and field issues from the region, resolving them through our ticketing system and keeping clear records. Expect roughly half your time here at the start, shifting toward site success work as you build relationships and the region's self-serve resources grow.

- Configure and maintain EarthRanger sites: users, event types, patrol types, maps, and integrations with trackers and sensors.

- Know when a problem needs an engineer, and hand it over with the detail they need. 

Train and enable 

- Deliver EarthRanger training to rangers, biologists, analysts, and managers, from one-on-one coaching to multi-day workshops, in Spanish and English.

- Help build and translate training materials, help-center articles, and short videos for the region. 

Support national and multi-site deployments 

- Contribute to large rollouts across many protected areas: scoping, planning, data standards, and follow-through with government and NGO partners.

- Track your projects and communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly to partners and the internal team. 

What we are looking for 

Required 

- A conservation foundation. Either hands-on work in conservation or protected areas (ranger, biologist, park or reserve staff, NGO field or program staff), or a demonstrated commitment to conservation through study, volunteering, or community projects combined with experience supporting people who use software.

- Fluent in spoken and written Spanish and English.

- A track record of helping others succeed with a tool, a process, or a program: training, support, extension work, community engagement, or teaching.

- Comfortable learning web and mobile software and explaining it to people who are not, and open to using AI tools every day for drafting, translating, troubleshooting, and learning. You do not need to be a programmer.

- A self-motivated remote professional with strong time-management skills: able to balance multiple projects simultaneously, structure their own daily schedule, meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and ask for help when needed.

- Able to travel within Latin America less than 10% of the year. 

Bonus 

- Portuguese.

- Hands-on experience as a user of EarthRanger or SMART. Many sites in the region are moving from SMART to EarthRanger, and knowing how patrol and monitoring data are collected in practice helps a great deal.

- Experience with GPS trackers, camera traps, or other field monitoring technology.

- GIS skills (QGIS, ArcGIS) and comfort working with spatial data.

- Experience working with government agencies or on multi-site, national-scale programs.

- Experience facilitating workshops or building training materials.

- Familiarity with data concepts such as spreadsheets, CSV exports, JSON, or APIs, used for troubleshooting rather than coding. 

Why Join Nimble Gravity? 
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk. 

Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

postings.title: Copilot & Power Platform Architect
postings.description:
About the Role

Nimble Gravity is looking for a Copilot & Power Platform Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise automation and AI-enabled solutions for our clients.

This is a client-facing consulting role where you’ll own the technical architecture end-to-end: from discovery and stakeholder workshops through build, governance, and deployment. You’ll architect Copilot Studio agents and Power Platform solutions that integrate seamlessly into Microsoft 365 environments—while ensuring the governance, security, and ALM practices needed to scale.

This role is approximately 80% client delivery, with opportunities to shape internal standards (10%) and support pre-sales solutioning (10%). You’ll collaborate with data engineers, AI specialists, and delivery leads who share a bias toward shipping high-quality work that creates real value.

What You’ll Do

Architecture & Delivery

- 

Design and deliver end-to-end Power Platform solutions across Power Apps (Canvas + Model-driven), Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Pages, selecting the right tools based on business goals and platform constraints.

- 

Architect and deploy Copilot Studio agents embedded into real workflows, leveraging patterns such as RAG, prompt orchestration, grounding, and tool calling when appropriate.

- 

Define scalable integration patterns across Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook), Azure services, and third-party systems via APIs, custom connectors, and on-premises gateways.

- 

Establish strong ALM practices in client environments: solution packaging, managed solutions, environment strategy, deployment pipelines, and release controls.

Governance & Security

- 

Build governance frameworks that scale: environment segmentation, tenant strategy, DLP policies, RBAC, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.

- 

Define guardrails for responsible AI: data boundaries, access controls, privacy/compliance considerations, auditability, and monitoring.

- 

Design identity and security architecture with Entra ID, ensuring solutions meet enterprise security requirements.

Client Leadership

- 

Lead discovery workshops to assess current state, capture requirements, and define target architecture.

- 

Produce clear client-ready deliverables: technical design docs, architecture diagrams, and implementation roadmaps.

- 

Communicate tradeoffs and recommendations to both technical teams and executive sponsors, tailoring your approach to the audience.

- 

Support pre-sales as needed: scoping, estimation, solution design, and technical demos.

Enablement

- 

Contribute to Nimble Gravity’s internal standards: reference architectures, templates, governance playbooks, and reusable patterns.

- 

Coach client makers and pro developers on best practices, including Center of Excellence (CoE) patterns and enterprise operating models.

What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

- 

5+ years architecting and delivering Microsoft Power Platform solutions in enterprise environments (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse).

- 

Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and/or Microsoft 365 Copilot, including custom copilots/agents integrated into business processes.

- 

Strong command of Power Platform governance: environment strategy, DLP policies, ALM, and tenant administration.

- 

Proven experience designing integrations across Microsoft 365, Azure services, and external systems using connectors/APIs/gateways.

- 

Experience leading client-facing consulting engagements: workshops, technical documentation, and stakeholder presentations.

- 

Deep understanding of identity and access management with Entra ID (Azure AD).

- 

Working knowledge of AI solution patterns relevant to Copilot implementations: RAG, prompt design, grounding, evaluation.

- 

Excellent communication—able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences without losing precision.

- 

Ability to travel occasionally (~10–20%).

Nice to Have

- 

Microsoft certifications: PL-600, PL-200, PL-400, MS-600, and/or AI-related certifications.

- 

Experience with Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Cognitive Services).

- 

Exposure to data platforms like Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Synapse.

- 

Familiarity with Power BI development and integration with Power Platform solutions.

- 

Consulting background at a Microsoft Partner/SI/professional services firm.

- 

Experience implementing CoE toolkits and enterprise-scale governance programs.

- 

Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC2, HIPAA, FedRAMP).

- 

Pro-code skills (C#, TypeScript, Python) to extend solutions via custom components, Azure Functions, or integrations.

We're looking for a Principal Databricks Architect to lead lakehouse and platform modernization engagements while serving as Nimble Gravity's primary technical voice in our Databricks partnership. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical architecture and client-facing strategy — equally comfortable designing Unity Catalog governance patterns as leading an executive workshop or shaping a scope of work.

Candidates must have a current Databricks Champion certification and a track record of hands-on delivery across cloud, data, and emerging AI workloads are essential to doing this work credibly.

Architect and deliver

- Lead architecture for lakehouse implementations, platform migrations, and modernization programs on Databricks (Azure preferred).

- Design Delta Lake, medallion, and Unity Catalog patterns that balance performance, cost, governance, and speed to value.

- Own technical direction for migrations from legacy platforms (for example Teradata, Snowflake, Synapse, or on-prem warehouses) into Databricks and Fabric/Power BI ecosystems.

- Define standards for ingestion, orchestration, CI/CD, testing, observability, and FinOps.

- Maintain certification currency and help the wider team grow their Databricks credentials.

- Mentor engineers and run internal enablement sessions.

- Cloud platform depth, ideally Azure (ADLS, Entra ID, networking, DevOps), with working knowledge of AWS or GCP.

- Comfort in front of clients, from technical teams to C suite.

- Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a tradeoff to an executive and then go deep with an engineer.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about harnessing the power of technology to create impactful, sustainable solutions in the ever-evolving digital landscape.

Nimble Gravity has a proven track record in working with private equity-backed businesses, delivering tangible value creation for investors and leadership teams.

About the Role

Are you a leader who knows how to win business through private equity (“PE”) partnerships? Are you a builder who gets energy from opening doors and winning new customers? Are you passionate about the possibilities of how data science and AI will transform the way businesses operate? If so, we would love to hear from you!

The Principal, Private Equity will help scale Nimble Gravity’s PE business by building sponsor relationships, originating new opportunities, and converting those relationships into repeatable AI, data, and technology engagements across portfolio companies. The role will own a portfolio of PE relationships and opportunities, with a particular focus on creating sponsor-level pull-through across multiple portfolio companies. The role works across three routes to market: direct relationships with PE sponsors; strategic ecosystem partners such as Anthropic, Microsoft, and Databricks; and direct portfolio-company engagements that can expand into broader sponsor relationships. The ideal candidate has experience selling AI, data, or technology consulting services into the private equity ecosystem. Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of the private equity investor mindset will be essential in this role. 

What You'll Do

- Build and Deepen Sponsor Relationships. Serve as a trusted advisor to Operating Partners, deal teams, and portfolio-company executives. Develop trusted, multi-level relationships with new and existing sponsors, partnering with Nimble Gravity leadership on strategic accounts. Help identify where AI and data can drive value creation and translate those opportunities into actionable roadmaps.

- Drive Sponsor-to-PortCo Pull-Through. Turn sponsor relationships into repeatable opportunities across the portfolio. Connect sponsor priorities with portfolio-company needs, use successful engagements to build credibility, and create repeatable motions that expand across additional companies and sponsors.

- Help Scale the Private Equity GTM. Bring market feedback from sponsors and portfolio companies to leadership and cross-functional teams to sharpen Nimble Gravity’s PE offerings and messaging. Codify what works into reusable playbooks, POVs, ROI calculators, and case studies that show how Nimble Gravity uses AI and data to drive value creation from pre-close through exit.

- Execute and Improve the PE Channel Strategy. Own specific sponsors, campaigns, events, and outreach motions within the PE channel strategy. Originate new opportunities across sponsor, ecosystem, and direct portfolio-company routes, and recommend improvements based on what convert Communicate the benefits of work in PE-centric ways (e.g., EBITDA impact, revenue growth, cash flow, working capital, risk reduction, and exit readiness).

- Activate Strategic Ecosystem Partnerships. Work with Nimble Gravity’s strategic technology partners, including Anthropic, Microsoft, and Databricks, to create joint opportunities across the private equity ecosystem. Build relationships with partner PE teams, identify sponsor and portfolio-company opportunities, coordinate joint pursuits, funded programs, and events, and convert ecosystem relationships into measurable pipeline and revenue.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partner with Delivery, Marketing, Solutions, and leadership to shape opportunities and ensure strong execution. Stay commercially engaged after close while Delivery owns day-to-day execution, helping connect client outcomes to expansion opportunities across the sponsor and portfolio.

- Own Commercial Outcomes Through Expansion. Hold commercial ownership of assigned sponsor and portfolio-company accounts, from qualified opportunity through close, renewal, and expansion. Maintain the pipeline and forecast, lead proposals and negotiations, track account health through delivery, and identify follow-on opportunities as client needs evolve.

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of relevant work history, ideally selling technology or management consulting services to portfolio companies of private equity firms through private equity sponsors (“private-equity-as-a-channel”)

- Deep understanding of the private equity investor mindset, either as a consulting customer or directly within the value creation function of a PE firm; must be comfortable speaking to diligence models, value creation plans, and post-close operating cadence

- Experience building business through technology alliances, channel partners, or other ecosystem relationships; familiarity working with hyperscalers, AI platforms, or data platforms is a plus

- Proven track record of originating and closing complex consulting or technology engagements with PE sponsors or PE-backed companies, with measurable results in new sponsor relationships, portfolio-company engagements, and revenue; able to source opportunities, shape proposals, and win

- Enough technical fluency in enterprise data and AI to diagnose opportunities, ask the right questions, and bring the right solution leaders into the conversation

- Demonstrated success in an entrepreneurial environment, influencing senior stakeholders and mobilizing cross-functional teams without direct authority

- Experience building executive-level communications and presentations 

- Fluent English required

- Self-starter attitude that thrives in a fast-paced environment focused on customer growth

- Comfortable translating technology initiatives into EBITDA impact, cash flow, working capital, growth, and exit value; comfortable discussing payback, NPV, and IRR and building a credible business case with deal teams

This role is ideal for someone who loves working at the edge of what’s possible with LLMs, RAG, agents, semantic search, multimodal AI, and intelligent automation — and who wants to turn cutting-edge ideas into real, production-ready systems for clients across industries.

This position is open to candidates based in LATAM or the United States.
